title: Plan
description: A sequenced implementation plan. Every task is bite-sized, TDD-first, with exact code and commit message.

goal.description: One sentence: what this plan produces

tech_stack.description: Key libraries, frameworks, or runtimes involved

steps.description: Ordered steps. Each step is one action. Code steps include exact code. Test steps include exact command and expected output.

commit_message.description: Conventional commit message for this task

depends_on.description: IDs of tasks that must complete before this one

covers_criteria.description: IDs of acceptance criteria from spec@1 that this task covers. vector-challenger checks that every criterion ID appears in at least one task.

linked_spec.description: ID of the spec@1 this plan implements

spec_file_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the spec@1 file this plan implements (e.g. .claude/specs/SPEC-001.json). Propagated from spec@1.spec_file_path. Agents resolve it against workspace_root from the lambda-recon manifest.

spec_hash.description: Content hash (e.g. sha256:<hex>) of the spec@1 file at spec_file_path as it existed when this plan was created. Set by vector-planner. lambda-recon recomputes the current file's hash and compares it to this value to detect whether the spec changed after planning — a mismatch means the plan may not cover criteria added or changed since it was made.

linked_requirement.description: ID of the requirement@1 the source spec@1 implements. Propagated from spec@1.linked_requirement by vector-planner so the full requirement-to-code chain is traceable without re-reading the spec.
